name: Tutorial Admin
original_name: チュートリアル管理者
source:
"This world is full of hope. My management supports adventurers on their journey."

The first system NPC that academy students meet in XR, who politely tells them how to proceed in this world. Well, they haven't met [url=/c113636]sensei[/url] because he is not logged in normally. The tutorial work peaks in the spring because of the start of the school year. 
After that, they serve as various NPCs at the same time. However, in each role, their characteristic tone of voice remains the same and their appearance remains unchanged, leading us to suspect that their character did not get enough budget for development.　
It is suspected that the development cost was not enough. Although it is difficult to communicate with them, they seem to have many hidden fans because of their adorable appearance. 
Their gender is a mystery, and the male students at the school keep it under wraps that that is something they enjoy about them.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: System
Height: 134 cm
Occupation: Tutorial Administrator (and many more jobs)
